name: BoldSign
description: Let your AI work with BoldSign e-signatures (US, EU, CA or AU region): find documents and check who has signed, download signed PDFs and audit trails, send files or templates for signature, remind, revoke, extend or change signers, and browse templates, sender identities, contacts, teams, users and brands.
prerequisites: A BoldSign plan that includes the API (or a free Sandbox account) and an API key from API, API Key in the BoldSign app.
instructions:
## BoldSign
This connector works with **BoldSign**, the e-signature service by Syncfusion, through its REST API v1 on your account's region: US `https://api.boldsign.com`, EU `https://api-eu.boldsign.com`, Canada `https://api-ca.boldsign.com` or Australia `https://api-au.boldsign.com`. It lists and reads documents (mine, my team's, sent on behalf), templates, sender identities, contacts, teams, users and brands, downloads signed PDFs and audit trails, sends documents and templates for signature, reminds, revokes, extends, changes signers, prefills fields and manages contacts and sender identities.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to BoldSign (`https://app.boldsign.com`, EU accounts `https://app-eu.boldsign.com`) and open **API** in the left menu, then **API Key**. The API must be part of your plan.
2. Click **Generate API Key**, choose **Sandbox** (free, watermarked documents, 50 requests an hour) or **Live**, optionally set a validity date, and copy the key into `BOLDSIGN_API_KEY`. It is sent in the `X-API-KEY` header and has every scope.
3. Set `BOLDSIGN_API_URL` to the API address of your region (see above); the browser address after sign-in tells the region (`app-eu` is EU, `app-ca` Canada, `app-au` Australia, `app` US). No trailing slash.
4. Run `boldsign_list_documents` to check.

**Workflow**
- Status of documents: `boldsign_list_documents` (filter `status`, `search`, dates, `recipients`), `boldsign_list_team_documents`, `boldsign_list_behalf_documents`, then `boldsign_get_document` for each signer's status and the event history.
- Signed files: `boldsign_download_document` (PDF, or ZIP with format Individually) and `boldsign_download_audit_log`.
- Send from a template: `boldsign_list_templates`, `boldsign_get_template` for the role indexes and field ids, then `boldsign_send_from_template` with one `roles` entry per role.
- Send a file: `boldsign_send_document` with `file_urls` (or Base64 `files`) and `signers` with their `formFields`, or `use_text_tags` / `auto_detect_fields`. `boldsign_send_draft` sends a document saved as draft.
- Follow up: `boldsign_remind_document`, `boldsign_extend_expiry`, `boldsign_change_recipient`, `boldsign_prefill_fields`, `boldsign_get_embedded_sign_link` (a direct signing link), `boldsign_revoke_document`, `boldsign_delete_document`.
- Account: `boldsign_list_sender_identities`, `boldsign_get_sender_identity`, `boldsign_create_sender_identity`, `boldsign_list_contacts`, `boldsign_get_contact`, `boldsign_create_contacts`, `boldsign_update_contact`, `boldsign_list_teams`, `boldsign_get_team`, `boldsign_list_users`, `boldsign_get_user`, `boldsign_list_brands`, `boldsign_get_brand`, `boldsign_get_api_credits`.

**Sending is real: confirm first.** Sending, reminding, changing a signer and creating a sender identity email real people; a Live document is legally binding and may use API credits. Show the user the file or template, the signers and the message, and send only after a clear yes. Revoke and permanent delete cannot be undone.

**Reading the answers**: ids are GUID strings (`documentId`, `templateId`). Dates such as `createdDate`, `activityDate` and `expiryDate` are Unix timestamps in seconds; filters take ISO 8601. Document `status`: InProgress, Completed, Declined, Expired, Revoked, Draft, Scheduled. Signer `status`: NotCompleted, Completed, Declined, Revoked, Expired. Template roles are numbered from 1 (`roleIndex`). Form field `bounds` (x, y, width, height) are measured from the top left of the page. Sending is asynchronous: the answer carries the `documentId` at once; check `boldsign_get_document` a moment later (a failed send shows in its history).

**Paging**: lists take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (up to 100) and return `pageDetails` (`page`, `pageSize`, `totalRecordsCount`, `totalPages`) with `result` (`results` for teams). Beyond 10,000 documents pass `next_cursor` = the `cursor` of the last document.

**Limits and errors**: 2,000 requests an hour per account on Live, 50 on Sandbox, for API key and OAuth together; 429 means wait (`X-RateLimit-Reset`). 401 for a wrong or expired key, or a key used against another region's host; 403 when the plan lacks the API or the user may not see the item; 400 with an error message for invalid input (unknown role index, missing signer email, file not readable).


**Switched off at install**: `boldsign_revoke_document` and `boldsign_delete_document`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

BOLDSIGN_API_URL.label: API address (region)
BOLDSIGN_API_URL.patternMessage: Use https://api.boldsign.com, https://api-eu.boldsign.com, https://api-ca.boldsign.com or https://api-au.boldsign.com, without a trailing slash.

BOLDSIGN_API_KEY.label: API key
BOLDSIGN_API_KEY.help: BoldSign app, API, API Key, Generate API Key (Sandbox or Live). Sent as the X-API-KEY header.
BOLDSIGN_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: BoldSign refused the API key. Copy it again from API, API Key (it may have expired or been deleted), and check that BOLDSIGN_API_URL is the API address of the region the account lives in.
verifyHints.403: The key works but the plan or user may not use this API call. Check that the API is part of the BoldSign plan.
verifyHints.rate_limited: BoldSign allows 2,000 requests an hour on Live and 50 on Sandbox per account. Wait until X-RateLimit-Reset and try again.

tools.name: boldsign_list_documents
tools.description: List documents I sent or received, newest first: documentId, messageTitle, status, sender, signers with their status, cc, created, activity and expiry dates (Unix seconds), labels. Filter by text, status, date range, sender or signer email.

search.description: Text to look for in the title, document id, sender or recipient names.

status.description: Only documents in these states: WaitingForMe, WaitingForOthers, NeedAttention, Completed, Declined, Revoked, Expired, Draft, Scheduled.

transmit_type.description: Sent (by me), Received (to sign by me) or Both (default).

start_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601.

date_filter_type.description: What the date range applies to: SentBetween (sent date) or Expiring (expiry date).

brand_ids.description: Only documents of these brands (ids from boldsign_list_brands).

next_cursor.description: Paging beyond 10,000 documents: the cursor of the last document of the previous page.

sent_by.description: Only documents sent by these emails.

recipients.description: Only documents with these signer emails.

tools.name: boldsign_list_team_documents
tools.description: List the documents of my team (team admins: of the teams they manage), with the same fields and filters as boldsign_list_documents plus filters by team and user.

search.description: Text to look for in the title, document id, sender or recipient names.

status.description: Only documents in these states: WaitingForMe, WaitingForOthers, NeedAttention, Completed, Declined, Revoked, Expired, Draft, Scheduled.

transmit_type.description: Sent (by me), Received (to sign by me) or Both (default).

start_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601.

date_filter_type.description: What the date range applies to: SentBetween (sent date) or Expiring (expiry date).

brand_ids.description: Only documents of these brands (ids from boldsign_list_brands).

next_cursor.description: Paging beyond 10,000 documents: the cursor of the last document of the previous page.

team_ids.description: Only documents of these teams (ids from boldsign_list_teams).

user_ids.description: Only documents of these users (ids from boldsign_list_users).

tools.name: boldsign_list_behalf_documents
tools.description: List documents sent on behalf of others (through a sender identity), or sent on my behalf by others, with their status and signers.

page_type.description: BehalfOfOthers (default: documents I sent for others) or BehalfOfMe (documents others sent for me).

sender_emails.description: Only documents sent on behalf of these sender identity emails.

signers.description: Only documents with these signer emails.

search.description: Text to look for in the title, document id, sender or recipient names.

status.description: Only documents in these states: WaitingForMe, WaitingForOthers, NeedAttention, Completed, Declined, Revoked, Expired, Draft, Scheduled.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601.

brand_ids.description: Only documents of these brands (ids from boldsign_list_brands).

next_cursor.description: Paging beyond 10,000 documents: the cursor of the last document of the previous page.

tools.name: boldsign_get_document
tools.description: Read one document in full: title, status, files, sender, each signer (name, email, order, status, viewed, authentication, form fields with values), cc, history of events, expiry, reminder settings, labels, revoke or decline message.

tools.name: boldsign_download_document
tools.description: Download the document PDF: the signed PDF once completed, otherwise the current state. Several files come as one combined PDF or, with format Individually, as a ZIP.

format.description: Combined (one PDF) or Individually (a ZIP with one PDF per file).

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_download_audit_log
tools.description: Download the audit trail PDF of a document: every event (sent, viewed, signed, declined) with time, email and IP address.

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_get_embedded_sign_link
tools.description: Get a signing link for one signer of a document, to open the signing page directly (for example in your own app or to hand over in person). Set sign_link_valid_till to limit how long the link works.

country_code.description: Country calling code of the signer phone, for SMS signers (e.g. +49).

phone_number.description: Phone number of the signer, for SMS signers.

sign_link_valid_till.description: Expiry of the link, ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: boldsign_list_templates
tools.description: List templates: templateId, title, description, roles (index, name, default signer), created by, labels, sharing. Filter by text, type (mine, shared, all), creator, labels or dates.

search.description: Text to look for in the template title or id.

created_by.description: Only templates created by these emails.

on_behalf_of.description: Only templates of these sender identity emails.

shared_with_team_ids.description: Only templates shared with these teams.

tools.name: boldsign_get_template
tools.description: Read one template: title, message, files, roles (index, name, default signer, signer type) with their form fields (id, type, page, required), cc, brand, labels, settings. Role indexes and field ids are what boldsign_send_from_template needs.

tools.name: boldsign_list_sender_identities
tools.description: List sender identities (people you may send documents on behalf of): id, name, email, status (Pending, Verified, Denied), approval date, brand and notification settings.

search.description: Text to look for in the name or email.

brand_ids.description: Only identities linked to these brands.

tools.name: boldsign_get_sender_identity
tools.description: Read one sender identity by id or by email: name, email, status, brand, redirect URL and notification settings.

tools.name: boldsign_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the address book: id, name, email, phone, job title and company.

search.description: Text to look for in the name or email.

tools.name: boldsign_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact of the address book: name, email, phone number, job title and company.

tools.name: boldsign_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of the organization: teamId, name, number of users and created date.

search.description: Text to look for in the team name.

tools.name: boldsign_get_team
tools.description: Read one team: name, users with their roles and status, created and modified dates.

tools.name: boldsign_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the organization: userId, name, email, team, role (Admin, TeamAdmin, Member) and status (Active, Invited).

search.description: Text to look for in the user name, email or id.

tools.name: boldsign_get_user
tools.description: Read one user: name, email, team, role, status, created and modified dates and metadata.

tools.name: boldsign_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands of the account (logo, colours, email display name, signing page settings): brandId, brandName, isDefault. Use a brandId when sending to apply that branding.

tools.name: boldsign_get_brand
tools.description: Read one brand in full: name, logo, colours, email display name, redirect URL, disclaimer, document time zone and other signing settings.

tools.name: boldsign_get_api_credits
tools.description: Show the API credits of the plan: credits balance and how many are used. Each document sent through the API uses credits on credit-based plans.

tools.name: boldsign_send_document
tools.description: Send one or more PDF or Office files for signature. Give the files as public URLs (file_urls) or Base64 data URIs (files), the signers, and either form fields per signer, text tags in the document (use_text_tags) or auto_detect_fields. Returns the documentId; sending finishes in the background.

title.description: Title of the document, shown to signers.

message.description: Message in the signing request email.

enable_signing_order.description: true makes signers sign one after another in signerOrder.

expiry_date_type.description: Unit of expiry_value: Days (default), Hours or SpecificDateTime.

expiry_value.description: When the request expires, in the unit of expiry_date_type (default 60 days).

labels.description: Labels to tag the document with.

disable_emails.description: true sends no emails (use boldsign_get_embedded_sign_link to hand out signing links).

on_behalf_of.description: Send on behalf of this sender identity email (it must be Verified in boldsign_list_sender_identities).

signers.description: Signers: [{"name", "emailAddress", "signerOrder"?, "signerType"?: Signer, Reviewer or InPersonSigner, "privateMessage"?, "formFields"?: [{"fieldType": "Signature", "pageNumber": 1, "bounds": {"x": 100, "y": 600, "width": 200, "height": 40}, "isRequired": true}]}]. Field types include Signature, Initial, CheckBox, TextBox, DateSigned, RadioButton, Dropdown, Name, Email; bounds {x, y, width, height} are measured from the top left of the page; field ids may use letters, digits and underscores only.

file_urls.description: Public URLs of the files to send (PDF, Word, images). BoldSign downloads them. Not together with files.

files.description: Files as Base64 data URIs, e.g. "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0...". Not together with file_urls.

use_text_tags.description: true places fields from text tags written in the document.

auto_detect_fields.description: true turns form fields and blank lines found in the file into fields.

meta_data.description: Your own key/value data stored with the document.

tools.name: boldsign_send_from_template
tools.description: Send a document for signature from a template. Fill each template role (by roleIndex from boldsign_get_template) with a real signer and optionally prefill its fields. Returns the documentId.

title.description: Title of the document, shown to signers.

message.description: Message in the signing request email.

enable_signing_order.description: true makes signers sign one after another in signerOrder.

expiry_date_type.description: Unit of expiry_value: Days (default), Hours or SpecificDateTime.

expiry_value.description: When the request expires, in the unit of expiry_date_type (default 60 days).

labels.description: Labels to tag the document with.

disable_emails.description: true sends no emails (use boldsign_get_embedded_sign_link to hand out signing links).

on_behalf_of.description: Send on behalf of this sender identity email (it must be Verified in boldsign_list_sender_identities).

roles.description: One entry per role to fill: [{"roleIndex": 1, "signerName", "signerEmail", "signerOrder"?, "privateMessage"?, "existingFormFields"?: [{"id": "<field id>", "value": "..."}]}]. Roles left out keep the template default signer.

role_removal_indices.description: Role indexes to drop from this document.

tools.name: boldsign_send_draft
tools.description: Send a document that is still a draft (status Draft) to its signers.

tools.name: boldsign_remind_document
tools.description: Email a reminder to signers who have not signed yet: all pending signers, or only the given emails.

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_revoke_document
tools.description: Revoke (cancel) a document that is in progress: signing stops and the signers are told why. It cannot be resumed.

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document: it moves to the trash, or is erased for good with delete_permanently.

delete_permanently.description: true erases it for good instead of moving it to the trash.

tools.name: boldsign_extend_expiry
tools.description: Extend the expiry date of a document that is still in progress, optionally warning the signers.

new_expiry_value.description: New expiry: a date yyyy-MM-dd for documents with expiry in days, a number of hours for expiry in hours, an ISO 8601 date-time for a specific date-time expiry.

warn_prior.description: true warns the signers before the new expiry date.

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_change_recipient
tools.description: Replace a signer who has not signed yet with another person (new name and email); the new signer gets the request.

old_signer_email.description: Email of the signer to replace.

reason.description: Reason for the change, shown in the audit trail.

order.description: Signing order of the signer to replace, when the same email signs more than once.

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_prefill_fields
tools.description: Set the values of form fields of a document in progress before the signers fill them (field ids from boldsign_get_document).

on_behalf_of.description: Email of the sender identity when the document was sent on behalf of someone (behalfOf in the document).

tools.name: boldsign_create_contacts
tools.description: Add one or more contacts (name, email, phone, job title, company) to the address book.

tools.name: boldsign_update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact of the address book: name, email, phone, job title, company (name and email are required).

tools.name: boldsign_create_sender_identity
tools.description: Ask a person to let you send documents on their behalf: BoldSign emails them an approval request; the identity is usable once its status is Verified.

brand_id.description: Brand to use for their documents.

redirect_url.description: Address to open after they approve.

notification_settings.description: Which emails they get: {"sent", "viewed", "signed", "completed", "declined", "revoked", "expired", "reminders", "attachSignedDocument", ...} as booleans.

locale.description: Language of the approval email, e.g. EN, DE, FR.
